model_system: SrTiO₃ focusing on Ti t₂g (dσ) orbitals and O 2p_z orbitals in the cubic perovskite unit cell

key_params.lattice: cubic perovskite, unit‑cell volume V≈254 Å³
key_params.phonon: frequency f≈3 THz (ω≈1.9×10¹³ s⁻¹), displacement Q(t)=Q₀(cos ωt, c sin ωt) with chirality c=±1, typical amplitude Q₀≈0.1 Å

headline_claim: A minimal molecular‑orbital model predicts two electronic contributions—atomic‑orbital polarization of Ti and inter‑atomic circulating currents around O—that generate a transient orbital magnetization large enough to account for the experimentally observed MOKE signal in SrTiO₃ under circularly polarized THz phonons.
replication_difficulty: medium – requires constructing and diagonalizing a small 6‑state tight‑binding Hamiltonian with time‑dependent hopping modulated by the phonon displacement.
